verdict.rationale: The docs describe a hosted MCP server through which an assistant like Claude can create, configure, and manage agents in your workspace using natural language, with nothing to install. An agents skill also lets you build and manage voice agents from AI coding assistants, and a probe confirms the official MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, documentation of which operations the MCP server covers, and a native natural-language interface inside the dashboard rather than via an external assistant.
